tier: Tier T2 Verified Fixture, UniProt P13569 & Cryo-EM Structural Coordinate Atlas
grounding_note: Evaluates 17 recorded ClinVar variation records (across 9 distinct CFTR protein changes), MyVariant.info annotations, and all 209 annotated natural variants in UniProt P13569 across RefSeq NM_000492.4 (27 exons) and 4 superposed human CFTR Cryo-EM structures (PDB 6MSM, 5UAK, 8EIQ, 8EJ1). No synthetic scores or unverified LoRA weights are used; every missing annotation is explicitly recorded as 'not stated'.

key_benchmark_findings.label: [observed]
key_benchmark_findings.summary: Sequence conservation vs. structural benignity split on Lasso-motif VUS R31L (VCV000054087, Exon 2/27): CADD Phred is 22.9 (top <1% conserved, GERP++ RS=437.4), whereas PolyPhen-2 (0.131, benign) and SIFT (0.13, tolerated) classify p.Arg31Leu as benign, matching ClinVar expert panel 'Uncertain significance'.

key_benchmark_findings.label: [observed]
key_benchmark_findings.summary: Codon degeneracy & review-tier asymmetry across identical protein changes: N1303K (NBD2, Exon 24/27), Y1092* (TMD2, Exon 20/27), W1282* (NBD2, Exon 23/27), and F508del (NBD1, Exon 11/27) each map to multiple ClinVar Variation IDs with distinct cDNA changes and review statuses (e.g., N1303K c.3909C>G [uid 7136, practice guideline, 52 SCVs] vs. c.3909C>A [uid 4818550, single submitter, 1 SCV]).

key_benchmark_findings.label: [observed]
key_benchmark_findings.summary: ClinVar 'drug response' classification on TMD2 pore/hinge missense variant D1152H (VCV000035867, Exon 21/27, review_status: reviewed by expert panel, trait: 'ivacaftor response - Efficacy'): binary pathogenic/benign classifiers misrepresent pharmacogenomic residual-function variants without a separate modulator-response label.

key_benchmark_findings.label: [computed]
key_benchmark_findings.summary: Across the 209 UniProt P13569 natural variants superposed onto Cryo-EM structures 6MSM/5UAK/8EIQ/8EJ1, 191 are resolved in 3D C-alpha coordinates in 6MSM while 18 fall in unplaced intrinsically disordered regions (primarily the R-domain, residues 631-845, Exon 14/27), and 17 lie within <=3 codons of an exon-intron boundary.
